# FabFashion — Shirting Fabric Manufacturer & Exporter

> FabFashion is a B2B premium fabric manufacturer and exporter based in Mumbai, India, with a 50+ year legacy, producing cotton, blended, linen, and custom-woven fabrics for global fashion brands and garment exporters.

Operating a 60,000+ sq ft manufacturing facility equipped with 42+ Toyota JAT810 looms operating at 1100 RPM and digitally controlled humidification systems, FabFashion delivers over 15 Lac+ metres per month in production capacity. The company is family-owned and led by Directors Mr. Prahaldraj Bhutra, Mr. Damodar Bhutra, Mr. Pratham Bhutra, and Mr. Pranav Bhutra.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: FabFashion Fabrics Pvt. Ltd.
- **Founded**: 1974 (50+ years heritage)
- **Headquarters**: Office No 402, Ajmera Midtown, Popatwadi Corner, Kalbadevi Road, Mumbai — 400002, Maharashtra, India
- **Main Factory**: 13/167/06 Rajmahal, Awade Nagar, Ichalkaranji, Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India — 416115
- **Phone**: +91 98234 44744 / +91 82089 90130

## Detailed Product Catalog & Technical Specifications

| Fabric Weave | Composition | GSM Range | Key Features & Applications |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Oxford Weave | 100% Combed Cotton | 110–130 GSM | Classic basket-weave construction, durable, soft finish for formal and casual shirting. |
| Twill Fabric | 100% Giza Cotton | 120–145 GSM | 2/1 diagonal ribbed pattern, soft drape, wrinkle resistance, luxury shirting. |
| Poplin & Stripes | 100% Cotton | 90–115 GSM | Ultra-fine tightly woven plain weave, breathable, crisp hand feel. |
| Herringbone Pattern | Cotton / Poly Blend | 130–160 GSM | V-shaped twill weave, high dimensional stability, rich visual texture. |
| Custom Weaves | As Specified | Custom GSM | Engineered to buyer specifications, custom yarn counts and pick rates. |
| Linen Blend | Linen / Cotton Blend | 140–180 GSM | Natural moisture-wicking breathability with cotton softness. |
